Name: More Item Info
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[list=1]
[*]Have you ever hovered over an item in your inventory wishing you could instantly know how many you’ve stashed away—broken down by quality—in all your chests?
[/list]
[b]More Item Info[/b] eliminates the guesswork by adding smart tooltips to your open inventory:

[list]
[*][b]Instant Chest Counts[/b]: Hover on any item and see exactly how many are stored in your chests, automatically totaled.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Quality Breakdown[/b]: Each tooltip lists counts for Normal, Silver, Gold, Iridium—and even Prismarine or mod‑added qualities—on separate lines with colored icons.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]No Lag, All Cache[/b]: Data refreshes only when you open your inventory or close chests, keeping performance.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Fully Configurable[/b]: Toggle tooltips, choose to show only stocked items, use official quality names, or enable debug logging via [code]config.json[/code]
[/list][b]
[/b][list]
[*][b]Universal Coverage[/b]: Works on every item, from wild forage to modded relics.
[/list][b]Usage
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Open your inventory.
[*]Hover over any item icon.
[*]Admire the neatly organized tooltip showing chest counts by quality—no extra steps needed.

[/list][b]Installation
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download [b]More Item Info[/b].
[*]Extract the folder into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]
[*]Launch with SMAPI and enjoy instant item insights!
[/list]
